comments.body:
I’m in it currently, and so far I’m really enjoying it.

The lab work is balanced with the courses pretty well, you generally will only have classes on Monday and Tuesday then will be in the lab the rest of the week (with potentially more time if you’d prefer). 

I also don’t think it’s much of a problem if you have less interest in one of the subjects. Finding someone with equal interest in each of them is probably pretty rare. Plus, even if it’s not your main interest, they all tend to overlap somewhat so it will, if nothing else, reinforce the things you do care about.

As for the admissions process, Id say everyone will have different experiences but it’s nothing too special, just one interview as far as I️ know. I️ did have some research during my bachelors that I️ think helped but I️ don’t believe it’s a firm requirement. I️ didn’t apply to to many other programs either, I️ liked the looks of this one more!

I️ hope this still helps even though it’s a little late!
comments.author: AVeryGoofyGoober
